parameters.name: CheckUrl
parameters.description: The URL that is used for health checks.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: You can add up to 20 domain names to DCDN for each of your Alibaba Cloud account. If you specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. If you do not specify a value for this parameter, the system uses the ID of the default resource group.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
The acceleration region. Default value: domestic. Valid values:

*   domestic: Chinese mainland
*   overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
*   global: global

parameters.name: Sources
parameters.description: The information about the addresses of origin servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn batch-add-dcdn-domain --domain-name example.com,example.org --resource-group-id testID --sources content_:_10.10.10.10_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:80,_weight_:_15 --check-url www.example.com/test.html --scope domestic --top-level-domain example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn BatchAddDcdnDomain --region cn-hangzhou --CheckUrl 'www.example.com/test.html' --ResourceGroupId testID --Scope domestic --DomainName 'example.com,example.org' --TopLevelDomain 'example.com' --Sources 'content_:_10.10.10.10_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:80,_weight_:_15'
